topic.source_contract: HM Land Registry Local Land Charges search and migration evidence

facts.guard: search result is not HMLR title or planning permission

facts.migration: after migration the national register replaces the local-authority LLC source
facts.guard: migration status must be checked for the relevant authority
a charge entry must be matched to exact land and current status
migration guidance is not a candidate-specific search
service availability is not proof that a parcel has or lacks a charge

scope_guards: Local Land Charges and HMLR title-register entries are distinct evidence systems.
A free personal search and a paid official certificate are distinct outputs.
The relevant authority's migration status must be checked before selecting the authoritative search route.
A local land charge can affect land without proving ownership, planning permission or current occupation.
Search geometry and charge extent must be matched to the exact land searched.
An absent result is not a substitute for planning history, title, environmental or highways searches.
Historic or corrected charge entries require chronology and cancellation-status review.
No score or promotion is written without an exact current LLC search, title relation and underlying authority evidence.
